summary: Massacre by political leader during elections; witness abduction leading to habeas corpus; court witness intimidation; hostile witnesses; flawed trial proceedings; High Court ignored directions; trial judge negligence; prosecution misconduct; appellate review of acquittal; standard of benefit of reasonable doubt; evidence evaluation in absence of fair trial; improper affidavit reliance; judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.147, s.148, s.149/307, s.302
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Trial Court acquittal set aside; matter remanded to Sessions Court for retrial with proper security measures and adherence to High Court directions.
